analysisKind: Ordinary Python read-only ELF relocation and IL2CPP CodeGenModule/metadata association of existing REA call observations; not a new REA Evidence record.

rootLabelAudit.method: Exact CodeGenModule method pointer from metadata token RID independently agrees with ELF unwind FDE initial PC; original sample and decoded span lie inside that FDE code range. USYM source-file/line is retained separately, not used as the method-identity key.
limitations: An unwind code range corroborates static code membership; it does not make the selected instruction sample complete function analysis.
USYM raw +8 identity remains untrusted when naming global metadata methods. Source-file/line mapping and exact CodeGenModule association are reported separately.
Shared method pointers, inlining and generic-body aliases remain possible; no target execution or runtime coverage is claimed.

sourceMapConflict.description: Earlier USYM +8 values were only candidate method indices. Being in range does not prove identity. Exact CodeGenModule pointer/token matching disagrees with some guessed USYM method names. Source files/lines remain independent observations; do not label callees from the guessed index.

interpretation.claim: The existing camera sample has a direct branch whose exact target equals this declaration method pointer.
Existing camera sample directly branches to a method pointer associated with the FOV setter.
The existing camera sample directly branches to smoothDeltaTime, not a generic assumption of deltaTime.
Two observed camera branches share this exact target.
The collision sample initial vector-return call matches the impulse getter, not relativeVelocity. Subsequent vector magnitude arithmetic must be described accordingly.
All three observed calls in corrected suspension sample share this pointer. This does not prove any ground-query API.
The camera speed scalar field layout, complete smoothing algorithm and constants are not recovered by identifying API pointers.

limitations: Associations use exact static ELF VA equality, relative relocation addends, metadata image identity and method token RID, never nearest-symbol naming.
R_AARCH64_RELATIVE entries are evaluated at image base zero; actual runtime ASLR base is not observed. Both static branch and table association use this same VA space.
A method pointer shared by several declarations remains ambiguous. Generic-instantiation tables, import trampolines and runtime helper names are not recovered by module tables.
Even one matching declaration does not establish every runtime call path or original source. No native target was executed and no tuning coefficient was recovered.
Existing USYM exact frames may represent inlining or shared code; they do not override codegen-pointer ambiguity.
No large ELF analysis tool, new package installation, product-file modification or document update was performed.
USYM candidate method identifiers are not trusted as global metadata method identity after the observed disagreement with exact CodeGenModule token-pointer association.
publicationBoundary: This summary contains addresses, digests, public declaration names and Assets-relative source names only. No commercial code/media, APK payloads, developer personal path prefixes or private credentials.
